items.title: Prosperity Bancshares: 3 Key Takeaways for Long-Term Investors
items.summary: Prosperity Bancshares announced a 6.7% dividend increase to $0.64 per share and projects double-digit earnings-per-share growth in 2027 driven by net interest margin expansion and merger cost savings. The bank completed system integration for recent acquisitions and expects $65-70 million in additional pretax cost savings, while maintaining disciplined credit standards rather than aggressive loan growth.

items.title: Prosperity Bancshares (PB) Q3 Earnings Beat Estimates
items.summary: Prosperity Bancshares reported Q3 2026 earnings of $1.67 per share, beating consensus estimates of $1.63, but revenues of $495.7 million missed expectations by 0.46%. The stock has underperformed the S&P 500 year-to-date, gaining only 0.8% versus the market's 12.8% gain. The company received a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) rating, suggesting near-term performance in line with the market.
